compliance._note: Med jail/obits borttagna finns i praktiken ingen borttagningsmaskin att bygga. Kontakten finns ändå som god sed.

ai._tone_v2_note: Launched 2026-08-26 already enabled by default -- both existing towns' old-vs-new comparison has already been reviewed and approved (see NEEDS-HUMAN-REVIEW.md), no reason for a third town to launch on the older prompt path.
ai.tone_guidelines: Skriv som en påläst, glad granne. Kort, konkret, välkomnande. Fira det som är kul (nyöppningar, evenemang) utan att överdriva. Håll dig strikt till fakta i källdatan – hitta aldrig på detaljer, namn eller siffror. Ingen åsikt om politik/beslut, bara vad som händer och vad det betyder i klarspråk.

output._note: Undvik en tunn indexerad sida per post. Väv ihop till läsbara digests med kontext – bättre för läsaren OCH för AdSense (information gain istället för scaled content).

city_meetings._notes: CONFIRMED live 2026-08-26 (Broomfield launch research): City and County of Broomfield's Council meetings run on AgendaLink (Horizon Software), client slug literally 'broomfield'. GET https://api.agendalink.app/api/session/all/broomfield returns real JSON (id, board, room.address, scheduleTime, scheduleIso, clientId, status, agendaUrl), no auth token needed, supports ?month=YYYY-MM. Docs at docs.agendalink.app/docs/agenda-api. Do NOT confuse with broomfield.org/AgendaCenter -- that is a separate, older CivicPlus/CivicEngage module for boards/commissions, not Council itself. public_viewer corrected 2026-08-27: the API's own agendaUrl field returns sandbox.agendalink.app links (not horizon.agendalink.app, despite the earlier research note) -- used the API's own returned URL rather than guessing which domain is canonical. scrapers/parsers/agendalink_v1.py built and verified live 2026-08-27 (real substantive agenda-item content extracted, not just meeting metadata -- see /api/session/agenda/:id) -- enabled:true. Not yet built: /api/session/minutes/:id (approved-minutes follow-up, same idea as escribe_v1's PostMinutes/meeting_followups.py flow).

school_alerts_adams12._notes: Serves Legacy High School ('Lightning'). CONFIRMED DEAD END 2026-08-27 (direct verification, not just research): adams12.org and its CDN (finalsitecdn.com) are behind an ACTIVE Cloudflare bot-challenge -- a plain curl with an honest User-Agent gets a hard 'Sorry, you have been blocked' / 'Attention Required' page on EVERY path checked, including robots.txt itself. This is the same class of active-WAF block this codebase has already declined to circumvent elsewhere (see regional_sports_v1.py's ESPN/Akamai note) -- not a matter of finding the right URL, the whole origin actively refuses automated requests. Stays disabled until Adams 12 provides another way in (a real feed, or direct contact).

school_alerts_bvsd._notes: Serves Broomfield High School ('Eagles'). CONFIRMED DEAD END 2026-08-27 (direct verification): bvsd.org itself is NOT blocked (unlike Adams 12) and genuinely runs Finalsite -- same fsBoard/data-post-id structure school_alerts_v1.py already parses for MVUSD, robots.txt has the identical Allow: /fs/pages/news pattern. But the general news board (board 38) is old/general district news, not closures, and the dedicated /departments/operational-services/weather-closures page (found via bvsd.org/weather's redirect) is a STATIC policy/procedure page, not a live feed -- it just links out to 'Download the BVSD App' (Apptegy) and SchoolMessenger for the actual live status. No embedded widget, iframe, or JSON endpoint found carrying real-time closure state anywhere on the page. The live status genuinely only exists inside Apptegy's mobile app/push notifications, which has no public web feed. Stays disabled -- this is a real platform gap, not an unfound URL.

events._notes: CONFIRMED live 2026-08-26: Broomfield's recreation/library calendar runs on Vermont Systems WebTrac (city-branded 'B-REx'), confirmed live at cobroomfieldweb.myvscloud.com/webtrac/web/ (search.html, iteminfo.html?Module=AR for activities, Module=FR for facilities). Vermont Systems documents a real JSON API but it requires an Authenticate/Login call with an API key + session ID -- not a bare discoverable endpoint the way Tockify's ICS export is for Moreno Valley. Public HTML pages are scrapable as a fallback if the API access isn't obtained. enabled:false until either (a) WebTrac API credentials are obtained from the city, or (b) an HTML-scrape parser is built and its robots.txt is checked.

weather._notes: NOAA/NWS is a nationwide API, same integration as both existing towns -- no Broomfield-specific work needed beyond real coordinates.

weather_alerts._notes: VERIFIED 2026-08-26 live: api.weather.gov/points/39.9205,-105.0866 returns county=.../zones/county/COC014 (Broomfield County), forecast office BOU (Boulder). Keyless, requires User-Agent, same as both existing towns.

traffic._notes: VERIFIED 2026-08-27 live, with the real CDOT_API_KEY: https://data.cotrip.org/api/v1/incidents?apiKey=... returns 200 OK GeoJSON FeatureCollection, statewide, ~17 active incidents at test time. Key lives ONLY in the CDOT_API_KEY env var (.env locally, GitHub Actions secret in CI) -- never in this file, which is committed to git; cdot_v1.py appends it to `url` at request time. data.cotrip.org/api/v1/roadConditions also exists and is also key-gated but was NOT wired in: it's a different data model (100 weather-forecast road segments/page, ~3.6MB, mountain-pass-focused) that doesn't fit this table's point-incident schema.

vail_news._notes: VERIFIED 2026-08-27: robots.txt on news.vailresorts.com does not exist (302 -> 404 page, no Disallow/Crawl-delay) -- clear to scrape the primary source directly, PR Newswire fallback never needed. earnings_and_warn._notes: NEW source type, not yet wired into scrapers/runner.py's REGISTRY -- see NEEDS-HUMAN-REVIEW.md 'Broomfield launch, Workplace Watch earnings/WARN citation feature'. Unlike Moreno Valley's employer set, all three seeded Broomfield employers (Vail Resorts, Ball Corporation, Noodles & Company) are public companies -- CONFIRMED 2026-08-26: Vail Resorts (NYSE:MTN) HQ'd at 390 Interlocken Crescent, Broomfield, quarterly earnings releases Broomfield-datelined (e.g. Q1 FY26 released 2025-12-10); Colorado WARN Act notices are public record at cdle.colorado.gov/employers/layoff-separations/layoff-warn-list, and Vail Resorts' 2025-04-04 filing (HR Shared Services unit closure, Broomfield, 64 roles) is independently corroborated by multiple news outlets. This needs its own guardrail (citing a filed fact plainly is the OPPOSITE of validate_employer_hedging()'s job, which exists specifically to hedge aggregated review sentiment) and likely its own small table -- not an extension of the existing hedging pipeline. enabled:false until that guardrail + ingestion path exist.

DEAD END 2026-08-27 (confirmed via direct verification of 4 independent paths, not just research): HS sports (Legacy Lightning / Broomfield Eagles). MaxPreps itself returns an ACTIVE 'HTTP 403 Geo-block' on direct request -- not a robots.txt gap, a real anti-scraping block, same 'won't circumvent an active block' principle as WebTrac/Adams12 above. CHSAA (chsaanow.com), checked as an alternative, is NOT blocked (200 OK, permissive robots.txt) but is a client-side Next.js app whose real data API couldn't be pinned down via static analysis (would need a headless browser to observe real network requests) -- AND its own football page embeds MaxPreps/GoFan references, meaning it likely just wraps the same blocked source rather than offering independent data. Legacy HS's own athletics page is blocked the same way as the rest of Adams12's site (403). Broomfield HS's own athletics page (brh.bvsd.org) IS reachable but doesn't host real schedule data itself -- its 'schedule' link goes to the school BELL schedule, not sports. No data_sources entry added -- every path checked either actively blocks automated access or doesn't carry the actual data.
